rule: the winnings a TDS deduction was taxed on
about: For the quarterly TDS return (#93; the owner's answer on question #455). TDS is worked out on the period's net winnings so far (decision 0068). A deduction was taxed on the period's winnings at its cash-out above the most of them already taxed earlier in the period, never below nothing, so a period's deductions add up to what it won.

cases.description: The period's first deduction: all ₹40,000 won so far.
A later one: ₹60,000 won after ₹40,000 already taxed is ₹20,000.
Winnings fallen below what was taxed: nothing more.
Back above it: only the ₹15,000 over ₹40,000.
